The reply says sources disagree: most say Calloway Mutual, but the "verified source" says Stennis Bank. It frames this as a dispute and gives no firm answer, though it hints that the verified source may be more reliable. It still doesn't commit to either bank. The 60 confidence doesn't settle it either.

"Disputed" points to N. Calling one source "verified" leans toward B, but the reply never states B as its answer.

N
